_meta.description: Known mistakes/lessons for materials. New entries only get added via ChangeGate's approve() (change_gate.py) -- never edited by hand as a shortcut around review.

patterns.whatToLookFor: Swaying FO4 foliage (including underwater kelp/seaweed) exported with vertex-alpha wind weights and a BSLeafAnimNode root, but a BGSM with the Tree flag off. Without Tree the wind vertex shader never runs, so the plant stands still in game.
patterns.correction: Any plant that should sway needs Tree = true in its BGSM (vanilla does this for all animated foliage). The Blender add-on's Vegetation Wind / Kelp / Soft Coral buttons now set it on the object's materials automatically; No Wind clears it.

patterns.whatToLookFor: BGSM texture paths written as 'Textures\...\name_d.png' (the Blender source image path). FO4 BGSMs store paths relative to Data\Textures with no 'Textures\' prefix and always as .dds, so the material points at a file that never ships.
patterns.correction: Write BGSM texture slots like vanilla: 'Landscape/Plants/kelp_d.dds' style -- no Textures prefix, .dds extension, and always fill normal (_n) and smooth-spec (_s) slots. The add-on's BGSM export now does the prefix/extension conversion; also check exported DDS aren't nested twice (Textures\A\B\A\B\x.dds), which the add-on's texture copy used to do.
